# FDG5014

> AVOID having two overloads of the same method that both use default parameters.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.1.1 Member Overloading.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not a separate analyzer candidate: the FDG5015 body allows two overloads with default parameters when their required parameters have incompatible signatures. FDG5013 reports the compatible case, which is the one this rule warns about.
